description: This file computes SHA256 hashes of files in a distribution directory and writes the results to a checksum file. It imports modules for crypto, file system operations, and path manipulations, and utilizes utility functions for file existence checks and listing directory contents.

methods.name: sha256
methods.description: Computes the SHA256 hash of a given file asynchronously, returning a Promise that resolves to the hash string or null on error.
